purpose.name: LHM-like dynamic groundwater application
purpose.acceptance_object: Coupled application-system groundwater output with a reduced unsaturated-zone component
purpose.nonclaim: This is not a component-fidelity or Layer-ROM-versus-Full-Richards equivalence envelope.

authority.source_title: Validatie en toetsing LHM 4.1, Deelrapport 1: Grondwater
authority.report_context: HKV / Acacia Water / Berendrecht Consultancy validation of LHM 4.1

domain_population.spatial_classification: Measurement locations are evaluated within report-defined hydrotypes/area types; freatic absolute criteria differ for Holoceen, Pleistoceen and Sterk hellend.
domain_population.population_rule: Each listed 80% criterion applies to measurement points in the governed area/population as stated by the report.

temporal_semantics.ghg_glg_sampling: Model output must be sampled conformably with the measurement series. GHG/GLG use groundwater levels on the 14th and 28th of each month; if unavailable, nearest observation within +/-4 days. With at least 20 observations in a hydrological year (April-March), the three highest and three lowest are averaged to HG3/LG3; yearly HG3/LG3 are then averaged to GHG/GLG.
temporal_semantics.amplitude: Groundwater dynamics amplitude is GHG minus GLG.
temporal_semantics.drought_recession: For prolonged drought, the report evaluates 2018 and 2019. Recession is the gradient from the highest head in 1 April-1 June to the lowest head after 1 July; the acceptance quantity is relative prediction error in that gradient.
temporal_semantics.lowest_head_timing: The timing difference of the lowest groundwater level is defined diagnostically but has no formal acceptance criterion in the source.
temporal_semantics.weekly_monthly_rise_fall: Weekly and monthly rise/fall relative errors are diagnostic analyses in the source; they are not promoted here to formal acceptance gates.

aggregation_rule: Vector gate. Do not collapse criteria to one weighted score. Apply each criterion only to its stated quantity, depth class, area type, population and temporal construction.

event_vs_cumulative_semantics.event_specific: Drought recession gradient for the report-defined prolonged drought periods.
event_vs_cumulative_semantics.long_term_statistics: GHG, GLG and GHG-GLG amplitude constructed over hydrological years as defined above.

extremes.governed: Drought recession criterion for the report-defined 2018 and 2019 prolonged drought periods.
extremes.not_governed: No generic flood/wet extreme or lowest-head timing threshold is established.

authorized_use: Prospectively preregister a matching LHM-like end-to-end validation in which the coupled system containing the reduced unsaturated-zone component is compared with observations using exactly these external criteria.
Use this route without inventing a Layer-ROM structural-error allocation, because acceptance is judged directly on the application outputs.
prohibited_use: Do not apply these thresholds to synthetic ROM-PURPOSE Reference-Richards error panels.
Do not invert these groundwater criteria into one portable SWAP-MODFLOW exchange-flux tolerance.
Do not claim that passing this envelope proves Layer-ROM structural equivalence to Full Richards.
Do not change the population, temporal construction or thresholds after viewing reduced-model output.

candidate_execution.reason: The quantitative envelope is now frozen, but no matching observation-bound LHM-like Layer-ROM validation harness, population binding or blind panel has been preregistered in ROM-ACCEPT. Envelope freeze is a prerequisite, not execution by itself.
candidate_execution.next_gate: Freeze exact application dataset/population, model composition, reduced-component insertion point, blind comparison protocol and immutable metrics before any candidate response.

scientific_interpretation: A pass would establish fit-for-purpose of the complete matching application system under the external LHM criteria. It would not isolate reduced-component error or prove internal profile/process fidelity.
